title: 隧道分部開挖與支撐~Sequential excavation and support
focus: 分部開挖的地層支護互制、早齡襯砌與觀測回饋~Ground-support interaction, early-age lining and observational feedback in sequential excavation
summary: 分部開挖讓土岩的卸載、變形與支護成形交錯發生，最終斷面強度不能單獨說明施工期表現。本課以簡化反力曲線建立概念，再逐項檢視開挖面分割、早齡材料、仰拱閉合、收斂與防水介面。學員需用量測檢查每一個模型的邊界，將適配曲線、工程判斷及正式核准清楚區分。~Sequential excavation interleaves unloading, ground movement and support formation, so final-section strength alone cannot explain construction-stage behavior. The course begins with simplified reaction curves and then examines face subdivision, young materials, invert closure, convergence and waterproofing interfaces. Learners test each model boundary against observations and distinguish curve fitting, engineering judgment and formal authorization.
history: Crossrail的公開論文把噴凝土襯砌與地層互制及施工序列放在同一設計問題中，並回顧一九九二年Heathrow Express試驗隧道的軟土地下施工。二〇〇九年FHWA土建手冊提供另一套工程背景，二〇一四年公開的Stepney Green論文呈現側導坑序列與量測比較。這些文獻並不支持把某個縮短步距或增加厚度當成萬用解法；本課追蹤的是每一次邊界改變如何影響可觀測的力流。~Crossrail authors treat sprayed lining, ground interaction and construction sequence as one design problem, and discuss the 1992 Heathrow Express soft-ground trial tunnel. The 2009 FHWA civil manual provides another engineering reference, while the 2014 Stepney Green paper presents side-drift sequencing with monitoring comparisons. None makes a shorter advance or thicker lining a universal solution. This course instead follows how each changed boundary alters the load path and the observations needed to test it.

units.title: 地層支護曲線交點~Ground-support curve intersection
units.anchor: 地層支護曲線交點~Ground-support curve intersection
units.mechanism: 地層釋放變形時需求反力可能下降，已成形支護隨變形提供更多反力；交點代表特定簡化假設下的相容狀態。支護啟用前的位移會改變交點，兩條線並不是天然固定的材料常數。 假設u以mm計，pg=0.6-0.02u MPa、ps=0.01(u-10) MPa且u≥10；相等得u=23.33 mm、p=0.133 MPa，僅為線性示例。 把未觀測的先期變形設為零，會高估支護參與程度並錯估交點；即使後續曲線看似吻合，起始條件錯誤仍可能造成對施工變更的錯誤預測。~Ground reaction demand may decrease as displacement develops, while installed support mobilizes increasing resistance. Their intersection is a compatible state under specified simplifying assumptions. Displacement before installation changes that state; neither line is a universal material constant. Assume displacement u in mm, pg=0.6-0.02u MPa and ps=0.01(u-10) MPa for u≥10. Equating them gives u=23.33 mm and p=0.133 MPa, a linear illustration only. Setting unobserved pre-installation movement to zero can overstate support participation and misplace the intersection. A visually good later fit does not remove that initial-condition error or make predictions of a changed sequence reliable.
units.model: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設u以mm計，pg=0.6-0.02u MPa、ps=0.01(u-10) MPa且u≥10；相等得u=23.33 mm、p=0.133 MPa，僅為線性示例。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume displacement u in mm, pg=0.6-0.02u MPa and ps=0.01(u-10) MPa for u≥10. Equating them gives u=23.33 mm and p=0.133 MPa, a linear illustration only.
units.verify: 將收斂與支護應變資料配對，檢查啟用時間、初始位移和力換算的可辨識性；比較多個初始位移假設的交點，若量測不能區分它們，須保留解的範圍，不把一個最佳擬合當成唯一真實地層。~Pair convergence and support-strain histories, checking installation time, initial movement and force conversion. Compare intersections for alternative initial displacements. If observations cannot distinguish them, retain a range of solutions rather than treating a best fit as the uniquely correct ground response.
units.failure: 把未觀測的先期變形設為零，會高估支護參與程度並錯估交點；即使後續曲線看似吻合，起始條件錯誤仍可能造成對施工變更的錯誤預測。~Setting unobserved pre-installation movement to zero can overstate support participation and misplace the intersection. A visually good later fit does not remove that initial-condition error or make predictions of a changed sequence reliable.
units.misconception: 地層與支護曲線一旦相交便證明所有失效均已排除。~An intersection of ground and support curves proves every possible failure mode has been excluded.
units.practice: 每次比較先列出啟用位移、材料齡期與三維效應的處理方式，將模型結果交設計者連同失效模式審查，不能以曲線交點自行批准下一步開挖。~Before each comparison, list installation displacement, material age and treatment of three-dimensional effects. The designer reviews the model together with failure modes; an intersection alone cannot authorize the next excavation stage.

units.title: 分部面積與暴露尺度~Subdivided area and exposure scale
units.anchor: 分部面積與暴露尺度~Subdivided area and exposure scale
units.mechanism: 分割斷面改變同時暴露的面積與形狀，卻也新增接縫和施工介面。面積減少可能有利於控制某些局部機制，但總斷面與暫時支護仍需共同受力，不能將面積比例直接當作穩定度比例。 假設總斷面80 m²分為30、30、20 m²三部分，最大單部面積30/80=37.5%；每次假設進尺1 m時，最大單部原位開挖30 m³。 相鄰開挖面時間重疊而未更新模型，會形成比圖面預想更大的開放區；局部掉塊或變形增加可能被錯認為偶發材料問題，實際原因卻是施工序列偏離。~Subdivision changes simultaneously exposed area and shape while creating joints and construction interfaces. A smaller face can help control some local mechanisms, but the complete section and temporary supports still interact. Area ratios cannot directly represent stability ratios. Assume an 80 m² section divided into 30, 30 and 20 m² parts. The largest part is 30/80=37.5%; at an assumed 1 m increment its in-situ excavation is 30 m³. Overlapping adjacent excavations without updating the model creates a larger open region than planned. Increased movement or local falls may then be misclassified as isolated material problems when the underlying issue is a departure from the intended sequence.
units.model: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設總斷面80 m²分為30、30、20 m²三部分，最大單部面積30/80=37.5%；每次假設進尺1 m時，最大單部原位開挖30 m³。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume an 80 m² section divided into 30, 30 and 20 m² parts. The largest part is 30/80=37.5%; at an assumed 1 m increment its in-situ excavation is 30 m³.
units.verify: 將實際輪廓和階段記錄重疊，核對有無相鄰部分提前開放而使合併暴露面積變大；地質面誌與暫時支護狀態需同時保存，面積計算只用於幾何核對，穩定判讀由設計者另行完成。~Overlay surveyed profiles and stage records to check whether adjacent parts opened early and enlarged the combined exposure. Preserve geological logs and temporary-support status together. Use area calculations for geometric reconciliation; the designer separately evaluates stability and interaction.
units.failure: 相鄰開挖面時間重疊而未更新模型，會形成比圖面預想更大的開放區；局部掉塊或變形增加可能被錯認為偶發材料問題，實際原因卻是施工序列偏離。~Overlapping adjacent excavations without updating the model creates a larger open region than planned. Increased movement or local falls may then be misclassified as isolated material problems when the underlying issue is a departure from the intended sequence.
units.misconception: 把斷面分成三塊就能把所有荷載與風險降為三分之一。~Dividing a section into three parts reduces every load and risk to one third.
units.practice: 每日圖面同時標出已開挖、已支護和已閉合區，不只標累計進尺；任何部分重疊或順序調整，都須由現場技術負責人送設計審查。~Daily drawings distinguish excavated, supported and closed regions instead of showing accumulated advance alone. Any overlap or sequence change is referred by the site technical lead for design review.

units.title: 早齡受壓與強度發展~Early-age compression and strength development
units.anchor: 早齡受壓與強度發展~Early-age compression and strength development
units.mechanism: 新噴襯砌的強度與剛度隨齡期發展，受力開始時間可能早於材料達到長期性能。平均壓應力可檢查數量級，但彎曲、局部薄區與早齡徐變會使同一平均值對不同位置產生不同影響。 假設軸力N=300 kN/m、厚t=0.20 m，單位寬平均應力N/t=1500 kPa=1.5 MPa；若合成試驗強度2 MPa，比值為0.75，未含分項係數。 以二十八天強度取代初齡性能會掩蓋早期需求超過能力的時段，外表未裂也不能排除內部損傷；之後補足強度不會自動抹去既有裂縫和接縫缺陷。~Fresh sprayed lining gains strength and stiffness with age and may carry load before reaching long-term properties. Mean compressive stress checks scale, but bending, thin zones and early creep can make an identical mean stress have different implications at different locations. Assume axial force N=300 kN/m and thickness t=0.20 m. Unit-width mean stress N/t=1500 kPa=1.5 MPa. Against synthetic test strength 2 MPa, the ratio is 0.75 before any partial factors. Using mature strength for young lining hides intervals when demand may exceed available resistance. A crack-free surface does not exclude internal damage, and later strength gain does not automatically remove cracks or joint defects formed earlier.
units.model: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設軸力N=300 kN/m、厚t=0.20 m，單位寬平均應力N/t=1500 kPa=1.5 MPa；若合成試驗強度2 MPa，比值為0.75，未含分項係數。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume axial force N=300 kN/m and thickness t=0.20 m. Unit-width mean stress N/t=1500 kPa=1.5 MPa. Against synthetic test strength 2 MPa, the ratio is 0.75 before any partial factors.
units.verify: 把噴築時刻、溫度、核准早齡試驗與實際受力階段連起來，確認試體是否代表現場材料及養護；比較薄區和受彎位置，不能用較晚齡期強度回填較早的受力時段，差異需材料與結構人員審核。~Link spraying time, temperature, approved early-age tests and loading stages. Check whether specimens represent placed material and curing. Examine thin and bending zones; later-age strength cannot be substituted into an earlier loading interval without review by material and structural specialists.
units.failure: 以二十八天強度取代初齡性能會掩蓋早期需求超過能力的時段，外表未裂也不能排除內部損傷；之後補足強度不會自動抹去既有裂縫和接縫缺陷。~Using mature strength for young lining hides intervals when demand may exceed available resistance. A crack-free surface does not exclude internal damage, and later strength gain does not automatically remove cracks or joint defects formed earlier.
units.misconception: 材料最終強度合格便能證明所有早期受力都合格。~Acceptable final material strength proves that every earlier loading stage was acceptable.
units.practice: 交接表以齡期而非僅以日期配對荷載和試驗，未知早齡性能要明列；下一施工階段是否可開始，由核准的材料與結構審查流程判定。~Pair loading and tests by material age, not date alone, and explicitly list unknown early-age properties. Permission to begin the next stage follows the approved material and structural review process.

units.title: 薄弱截面與偏心彎曲~Weak sections and eccentric bending
units.anchor: 薄弱截面與偏心彎曲~Weak sections and eccentric bending
units.mechanism: 非圓斷面或不均勻荷載會使襯砌同時受壓與彎曲，厚度局部減少對彎曲應力的影響大於對平均壓應力的影響。線彈性截面分析只在未裂與適用材料假設下成立，需與真實受力機制分開。 假設每米寬N=200 kN、M=10 kN·m、t=0.25 m，σ=N/t±6M/t²=0.8±0.96 MPa，兩緣為1.76與-0.16 MPa，負值表示拉應力。 局部薄區在彎矩作用下先裂，原有內力分配可能重新調整；只看截面平均壓縮會忽略拉側與接縫開口，進而低估滲水和後續耐久風險。~Noncircular geometry and uneven loads produce compression and bending together. Local thinning affects bending stress more strongly than mean compression. Linear-elastic section analysis applies only under its uncracked material assumptions and must be separated from the full ground-lining mechanism. For a 1 m strip assume N=200 kN, M=10 kN·m and t=0.25 m. Stress is N/t±6M/t²=0.8±0.96 MPa: edges are 1.76 and -0.16 MPa, with negative indicating tension. A thin zone may crack first under bending and redistribute internal forces. Looking only at mean compression overlooks the tensile edge and joint opening, potentially understating leakage and subsequent durability concerns.
units.model: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設每米寬N=200 kN、M=10 kN·m、t=0.25 m，σ=N/t±6M/t²=0.8±0.96 MPa，兩緣為1.76與-0.16 MPa，負值表示拉應力。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. For a 1 m strip assume N=200 kN, M=10 kN·m and t=0.25 m. Stress is N/t±6M/t²=0.8±0.96 MPa: edges are 1.76 and -0.16 MPa, with negative indicating tension.
units.verify: 用厚度檢測與幾何掃描定位不利截面，應變計資料需校正溫度和齡期後才可換算內力；若彈性模型出現拉應力，應檢討裂縫與殘餘承載模型，不把負值直接截為零再宣稱通過。~Use thickness measurements and geometry scans to locate adverse sections. Correct strain records for temperature and age before inferring forces. If elastic analysis predicts tension, review cracking and residual resistance rather than clipping negative stress to zero and declaring success.
units.failure: 局部薄區在彎矩作用下先裂，原有內力分配可能重新調整；只看截面平均壓縮會忽略拉側與接縫開口，進而低估滲水和後續耐久風險。~A thin zone may crack first under bending and redistribute internal forces. Looking only at mean compression overlooks the tensile edge and joint opening, potentially understating leakage and subsequent durability concerns.
units.misconception: 平均應力是壓縮就表示襯砌每個位置都沒有拉裂。~Compressive average stress means that no part of the lining can develop tensile cracking.
units.practice: 圖表分別列軸力、彎矩和兩緣應力，保留正負號定義；出現開裂可能性時交設計者決定後續驗證與模型，不能只用平均值完成驗收。~Report axial force, moment and both edge stresses separately, preserving the sign convention. When cracking is possible, the designer determines further verification and modeling; a mean value cannot close acceptance.

units.title: 仰拱閉合與剛度改變~Invert closure and stiffness change
units.anchor: 仰拱閉合與剛度改變~Invert closure and stiffness change
units.mechanism: 開口支護和閉合環的力流不同，仰拱接通後可增加環向約束，但接縫柔度與地層接觸仍影響實際剛度。用等效彈簧比較只展示閉合改變，不聲稱結構一定立即成為完整圓環。 假設同一增量荷載ΔF=600 kN，開口等效剛度20 kN/mm、閉合後60 kN/mm，位移增量分別30與10 mm；兩剛度均為教學假設。 圖面已閉合但接縫未充分傳力，會讓計算剛度高於實際；若據此移除臨時構件，變形可能重新加速，顯示幾何閉合與力學閉合並不相同。~Open support and a closed ring have different load paths. Invert connection can add circumferential restraint, but joint compliance and ground contact still govern effective stiffness. Equivalent springs illustrate the change without claiming that closure instantly creates a perfect circular ring. Assume the same incremental force ΔF=600 kN. With equivalent stiffness 20 kN/mm before closure and 60 kN/mm after, displacement increments are 30 and 10 mm; both stiffnesses are teaching assumptions. A geometrically closed section with ineffective joints can be less stiff than assumed. Removing temporary members on that assumption may restart movement, demonstrating that geometric closure and effective structural closure are different conditions.
units.model: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設同一增量荷載ΔF=600 kN，開口等效剛度20 kN/mm、閉合後60 kN/mm，位移增量分別30與10 mm；兩剛度均為教學假設。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume the same incremental force ΔF=600 kN. With equivalent stiffness 20 kN/mm before closure and 60 kN/mm after, displacement increments are 30 and 10 mm; both stiffnesses are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 核對仰拱幾何、連接完成時間與材料齡期，將閉合前後收斂增量按相同施工事件比較；排除荷載變小或基準重設的影響，才討論剛度改變，任何等效值都須附上識別資料和不確定度。~Check invert geometry, connection completion and material age. Compare convergence increments around matching construction events before and after closure. Exclude reduced loading or reset references before attributing changes to stiffness; every inferred equivalent value needs supporting data and uncertainty.
units.failure: 圖面已閉合但接縫未充分傳力，會讓計算剛度高於實際；若據此移除臨時構件，變形可能重新加速，顯示幾何閉合與力學閉合並不相同。~A geometrically closed section with ineffective joints can be less stiff than assumed. Removing temporary members on that assumption may restart movement, demonstrating that geometric closure and effective structural closure are different conditions.
units.misconception: 仰拱外形接起來就代表完整承載能力立即形成。~Connecting the visible invert geometry means that full structural capacity is immediately available.
units.practice: 閉合紀錄同時確認幾何、接縫、齡期和核准試驗，未完成項不以照片代替；臨時支護調整前由結構負責人確認實際傳力條件。~Closure records verify geometry, joints, age and approved tests together. Photographs do not replace unresolved checks. Before altering temporary support, the structural lead confirms the actual load-transfer conditions.

units.title: 施工時間與剛度相容~Construction timing and stiffness compatibility
units.anchor: 施工時間與剛度相容~Construction timing and stiffness compatibility
units.mechanism: 相同軸力作用於不同齡期材料會產生不同彈性應變，而早齡徐變使單純彈性關係更受限制。施工時間表不只是管理資料，它決定各部分材料在荷載轉移時的剛度以及可能的內力再分配。 假設單位寬A=0.25 m²、N=300 kN，E=6 GPa時ε=N/(EA)=200微應變；E=12 GPa時為100微應變，未包含徐變與收縮。 較晚啟用的儀器漏記先期應變，與年輕材料的低剛度疊加後可能誤判荷載很小；若再忽略徐變，內力估計的方向甚至可能和真實變化不同。~Equal axial force produces different elastic strain in materials of different age, while early creep further limits a purely elastic relation. The construction timetable is therefore a mechanical input: it determines stiffness during load transfer and potential redistribution among components. Assume unit-width area A=0.25 m² and N=300 kN. At E=6 GPa, ε=N/(EA)=200 microstrain; at E=12 GPa it is 100 microstrain, excluding creep and shrinkage. Late gauge activation misses earlier strain and, combined with low young-material stiffness, can suggest falsely small loading. Ignoring creep adds further bias and may make the inferred force trend differ from the actual load-transfer history.
units.model: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設單位寬A=0.25 m²、N=300 kN，E=6 GPa時ε=N/(EA)=200微應變；E=12 GPa時為100微應變，未包含徐變與收縮。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume unit-width area A=0.25 m² and N=300 kN. At E=6 GPa, ε=N/(EA)=200 microstrain; at E=12 GPa it is 100 microstrain, excluding creep and shrinkage.
units.verify: 同步記錄噴築時間、環境溫度、材料試驗與應變計啟用時刻，核對零點是否在已受力後才設定；將彈性、溫度和時間效應分別列出，無足夠證據時不能把全部應變都換算成結構軸力。~Synchronize placement time, temperature, material tests and strain-gauge activation. Determine whether zero was established after loading had already begun. Separate elastic, thermal and time-dependent components; insufficient evidence precludes converting all measured strain directly into structural axial force.
units.failure: 較晚啟用的儀器漏記先期應變，與年輕材料的低剛度疊加後可能誤判荷載很小；若再忽略徐變，內力估計的方向甚至可能和真實變化不同。~Late gauge activation misses earlier strain and, combined with low young-material stiffness, can suggest falsely small loading. Ignoring creep adds further bias and may make the inferred force trend differ from the actual load-transfer history.
units.misconception: 量到的所有應變乘最終彈性模數就是當下內力。~All measured strain multiplied by the final elastic modulus gives the current internal force.
units.practice: 資料交接附上儀器零點時刻及材料齡期對照表，不能補填不存在的初始讀值；模型採用的剛度與時間效應由材料、監測和設計人員共同確認。~Handover includes gauge-zero times and material-age tables without inventing missing initial readings. Material, monitoring and design specialists jointly confirm the stiffness and time effects adopted in the model.

units.title: 收斂曲線與外推界線~Convergence curves and extrapolation limits
units.anchor: 收斂曲線與外推界線~Convergence curves and extrapolation limits
units.mechanism: 指數曲線可以摘要逐漸變慢的合成收斂，但擬合形式不會自動證明地層穩定。開挖距離、地下水和後續拆除都可能改變邊界，造成原先衰減的曲線重新加速，預測必須附帶情境。 假設u(t)=20[1-exp(-t/5)] mm，t以day計，u(5)=12.64 mm、u(10)=17.29 mm；極限20 mm只是模型參數，非現場允收限值。 將加速讀值當作離群點刪除，會讓擬合曲線看似穩定卻失去預警能力；當邊界已改變，延用舊極限值可能錯估後續變形與需要的審查。~An exponential curve can summarize synthetic convergence that slows with time, but its fitted form does not prove stability. Excavation distance, groundwater and later removals can change boundaries and restart acceleration. A forecast must therefore state the scenario under which it applies. Assume u(t)=20[1-exp(-t/5)] mm with t in days. Values are u(5)=12.64 mm and u(10)=17.29 mm; the 20 mm asymptote is a model parameter, not a field acceptance limit. Deleting accelerating readings as outliers can make a fitted curve look stable while removing its warning value. After boundaries change, retaining the old asymptote may misrepresent future movement and the need for engineering review.
units.model: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設u(t)=20[1-exp(-t/5)] mm，t以day計，u(5)=12.64 mm、u(10)=17.29 mm；極限20 mm只是模型參數，非現場允收限值。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume u(t)=20[1-exp(-t/5)] mm with t in days. Values are u(5)=12.64 mm and u(10)=17.29 mm; the 20 mm asymptote is a model parameter, not a field acceptance limit.
units.verify: 用保留的後期資料而非同一擬合樣本檢查預測誤差，將開挖和支護事件標在時間軸上；若殘差有系統性趨勢，應重新審查模型邊界，不能只增加曲線平滑程度讓異常看起來消失。~Test predictions on withheld later observations rather than only the fitting sample. Mark excavation and support events on the timeline. A systematic residual trend calls for boundary review; increasing smoothing until anomalies appear to vanish is not a valid response.
units.failure: 將加速讀值當作離群點刪除，會讓擬合曲線看似穩定卻失去預警能力；當邊界已改變，延用舊極限值可能錯估後續變形與需要的審查。~Deleting accelerating readings as outliers can make a fitted curve look stable while removing its warning value. After boundaries change, retaining the old asymptote may misrepresent future movement and the need for engineering review.
units.misconception: 曲線擬合出有限極限值就能證明隧道已穩定。~A fitted finite asymptote proves that the tunnel has reached a stable condition.
units.practice: 報告保留原始點、殘差與未參與擬合的驗證區間；外推只供情境比較，任何警戒與施工決定依核准觀測方案由負責工程師判斷。~Reports retain original points, residuals and a validation interval excluded from fitting. Extrapolation supports scenario comparison only; warning levels and construction decisions follow the approved observational plan and responsible engineer.

units.title: 防水介面與壓力分布~Waterproofing interfaces and pressure distribution
units.anchor: 防水介面與壓力分布~Waterproofing interfaces and pressure distribution
units.mechanism: 地下水壓力作用於可受壓的面積，防水層負責阻隔水路而非憑空消除外部水壓。排水與封閉防水的設計邊界不同，若把排水假設移植到不排水區，襯砌受力可能被低估。 假設均勻表壓p=150 kPa作用於局部平面A=2 m²，合力F=pA=300 kN；這是假設局部均壓，非整個彎曲襯砌的總合力。 排水通道堵塞後外水壓上升，內表面卻可能暫時仍乾燥；若僅以滲漏量評估荷載，會錯把防水效果良好當成結構沒有水壓需求。~Groundwater pressure acts over the pressurized area. Waterproofing blocks water paths rather than making external pressure disappear. Drained and sealed arrangements have different boundaries; applying a drainage assumption to a sealed region can understate lining demand. Assume uniform gauge pressure p=150 kPa on local plane area A=2 m². Resultant F=pA=300 kN applies to this idealized local patch, not the entire curved lining. After drainage blocks, external pressure may rise while the inner surface remains dry. Assessing loading from leakage alone can mistake effective waterproofing for the absence of a water-pressure demand on the structure.
units.model: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設均勻表壓p=150 kPa作用於局部平面A=2 m²，合力F=pA=300 kN；這是假設局部均壓，非整個彎曲襯砌的總合力。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume uniform gauge pressure p=150 kPa on local plane area A=2 m². Resultant F=pA=300 kN applies to this idealized local patch, not the entire curved lining.
units.verify: 核對設計排水路徑、孔壓量測及防水接縫驗證紀錄，將滲漏位置和水頭分開記錄；乾燥表面不能證明外壓為零，堵塞或排水條件改變時需由水文與結構負責人共同審查荷載假設。~Check designed drainage paths, pore-pressure observations and waterproof-joint verification. Record leakage locations separately from head. A dry surface does not establish zero external pressure; blockage or changed drainage requires joint hydraulic and structural review of the load assumptions.
units.failure: 排水通道堵塞後外水壓上升，內表面卻可能暫時仍乾燥；若僅以滲漏量評估荷載，會錯把防水效果良好當成結構沒有水壓需求。~After drainage blocks, external pressure may rise while the inner surface remains dry. Assessing loading from leakage alone can mistake effective waterproofing for the absence of a water-pressure demand on the structure.
units.misconception: 內表面沒有滴水就表示外側水壓可以忽略。~A dry inner surface means that external water pressure can be ignored.
units.practice: 交接同時保存防水品質和排水功能證據，明示長期維護責任；壓力邊界改變先送設計審查，不以乾燥外觀代替結構荷載確認。~Retain evidence of both waterproof quality and drainage function at handover, identifying long-term maintenance responsibility. A changed pressure boundary goes to design review; dry appearance does not replace confirmation of structural loading.

units.title: 反分析的多解問題~Non-uniqueness in back-analysis
units.anchor: 反分析的多解問題~Non-uniqueness in back-analysis
units.mechanism: 單一位移可能由較大荷載配較高剛度或較小荷載配較低剛度產生，因而不是所有參數都能由一條曲線辨識。反分析必須配合獨立地質、材料與內力量測，並報告可行參數的範圍。 假設u=F/k=10 mm，可由F=500 kN、k=50 kN/mm，也可由F=1000 kN、k=100 kN/mm得到；一個位移觀測無法區分兩組。 校準到單一斷面的模型可能只是參數互相補償，換到新地層或新序列便失準；若只公布最佳誤差不公布多解性，使用者會高估模型的預測能力。~The same displacement can result from larger force with higher stiffness or smaller force with lower stiffness. A single curve therefore cannot identify every parameter. Back-analysis needs independent geological, material and force evidence and should report feasible parameter ranges. An observed u=F/k=10 mm can arise from F=500 kN with k=50 kN/mm or F=1000 kN with k=100 kN/mm. One displacement observation cannot distinguish the two pairs. A model calibrated to one section may rely on compensating parameters and fail under a new ground condition or sequence. Reporting only its best error while hiding non-uniqueness encourages overconfidence in predictive capability.
units.model: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設u=F/k=10 mm，可由F=500 kN、k=50 kN/mm，也可由F=1000 kN、k=100 kN/mm得到；一個位移觀測無法區分兩組。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. An observed u=F/k=10 mm can arise from F=500 kN with k=50 kN/mm or F=1000 kN with k=100 kN/mm. One displacement observation cannot distinguish the two pairs.
units.verify: 先列出未知參數與獨立觀測數，再用不同參數組計算是否同樣符合位移；加入有物理意義的試驗約束而非任意縮小範圍，保留同樣可行的解，交設計者評估對後續序列的預測分歧。~List unknown parameters and independent observations, then test whether several parameter sets fit the displacement equally well. Add physically supported test constraints rather than arbitrary narrow bounds. Retain viable alternatives and have the designer evaluate their differing predictions for later stages.
units.failure: 校準到單一斷面的模型可能只是參數互相補償，換到新地層或新序列便失準；若只公布最佳誤差不公布多解性，使用者會高估模型的預測能力。~A model calibrated to one section may rely on compensating parameters and fail under a new ground condition or sequence. Reporting only its best error while hiding non-uniqueness encourages overconfidence in predictive capability.
units.misconception: 模型曲線完全吻合量測就代表所有參數都是真值。~An exact fit to measured movement means that every fitted parameter is its true value.
units.practice: 反分析文件附參數範圍、相關性和獨立驗證資料，任何用於變更設計的結論須標明仍未辨識項；由模型與設計負責人共同簽認適用情境。~Back-analysis records include parameter ranges, correlations and independent validation. Conclusions used for design changes identify unresolved parameters, and modeling and design leads jointly approve the applicable scenarios.

units.title: 分層襯砌交接與缺陷圖~Layered-lining handover and defect map
units.anchor: 分層襯砌交接與缺陷圖~Layered-lining handover and defect map
units.mechanism: 多層襯砌的品質需要逐層追溯，表層完成後會遮蔽接縫、修補與防水介面。缺陷面積比例只能摘要分布，缺陷是否位於力流轉折或滲水路徑比總百分比更影響後續檢查。 假設檢查面積200 m²、已確認需處置區8 m²，面積比8/200=4%；若其中2 m²位於關鍵接縫，不能被其餘192 m²良好區平均掉。 覆蓋後失去定位資訊會使後續滲漏無法連回原缺陷，維修只能猜測路徑；關鍵區域若被總體低缺陷率掩蓋，耐久與可維修性的問題便會延後暴露。~Layered lining needs traceability by layer because the final surface hides joints, repairs and waterproofing interfaces. Defect-area fraction summarizes distribution, but whether a defect lies at a load-path change or water route matters more than the overall percentage. Assume inspected area 200 m² and confirmed treatment area 8 m²: the fraction is 8/200=4%. If 2 m² lies at critical joints, the 192 m² of satisfactory area cannot average that issue away. Losing location information after covering a layer prevents later leaks from being linked to original defects. Repairs then rely on guesses, while a low overall defect rate can hide critical zones and postpone durability and maintainability problems.
units.model: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設檢查面積200 m²、已確認需處置區8 m²，面積比8/200=4%；若其中2 m²位於關鍵接縫，不能被其餘192 m²良好區平均掉。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume inspected area 200 m² and confirmed treatment area 8 m²: the fraction is 8/200=4%. If 2 m² lies at critical joints, the 192 m² of satisfactory area cannot average that issue away.
units.verify: 以坐標化照片、厚度點和修補批次建立逐層缺陷圖，抽查下一層施工前的停點簽認；每項處置需有原因、方法核准和完成證據，不能只交總合格面積而省略關鍵接縫的未閉合狀態。~Build layer-by-layer defect maps from located photographs, thickness points and repair batches. Audit hold-point approval before the next layer. Each treatment needs a cause, approved method and completion evidence; total accepted area cannot conceal unresolved conditions at critical joints.
units.failure: 覆蓋後失去定位資訊會使後續滲漏無法連回原缺陷，維修只能猜測路徑；關鍵區域若被總體低缺陷率掩蓋，耐久與可維修性的問題便會延後暴露。~Losing location information after covering a layer prevents later leaks from being linked to original defects. Repairs then rely on guesses, while a low overall defect rate can hide critical zones and postpone durability and maintainability problems.
units.misconception: 缺陷總面積比例很小便不必逐項交接其位置。~A small overall defective-area fraction removes the need to hand over each defect location.
units.practice: 未閉合缺陷與已完成修補分開列帳，保留覆蓋前影像和批准版本；品質、結構與維護代表共同確認可追溯資料後，才完成襯砌交接。~Separate unresolved defects from completed repairs and retain pre-covering images and approval versions. Quality, structural and maintenance representatives confirm the traceable evidence before the lining handover is closed.

example: 以下原創算例針對分部開挖的地層支護互制、早齡襯砌與觀測回饋，每個輸入都是教學假設而非地標實測資料。教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設u以mm計，pg=0.6-0.02u MPa、ps=0.01(u-10) MPa且u≥10；相等得u=23.33 mm、p=0.133 MPa，僅為線性示例。教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設總斷面80 m²分為30、30、20 m²三部分，最大單部面積30/80=37.5%；每次假設進尺1 m時，最大單部原位開挖30 m³。兩式只回答各自所列的量與邊界，不應把單一平均結果當成整體穩定證明。請另以最不利的幾何、時間或接觸條件代入，分別標示量測誤差和模型偏差；交接記錄須保留原單位、資料日期以及未能確認的條件。~This original worked example examines ground-support interaction, early-age lining and observational feedback in sequential excavation. Every input is a teaching assumption, not a measured value from a landmark. Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume displacement u in mm, pg=0.6-0.02u MPa and ps=0.01(u-10) MPa for u≥10. Equating them gives u=23.33 mm and p=0.133 MPa, a linear illustration only. Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume an 80 m² section divided into 30, 30 and 20 m² parts. The largest part is 30/80=37.5%; at an assumed 1 m increment its in-situ excavation is 30 m³. Each relation answers only its stated quantity under its stated boundary conditions. A favorable mean value is not proof of overall stability. Recalculate with an adverse geometry, timing or contact condition, distinguishing measurement uncertainty from model error. The handover record must retain original units, observation dates and conditions that remain unverified; the responsible designer decides whether additional evidence is needed.
facts: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設u以mm計，pg=0.6-0.02u MPa、ps=0.01(u-10) MPa且u≥10；相等得u=23.33 mm、p=0.133 MPa，僅為線性示例。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume displacement u in mm, pg=0.6-0.02u MPa and ps=0.01(u-10) MPa for u≥10. Equating them gives u=23.33 mm and p=0.133 MPa, a linear illustration only.

教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設總斷面80 m²分為30、30、20 m²三部分，最大單部面積30/80=37.5%；每次假設進尺1 m時，最大單部原位開挖30 m³。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume an 80 m² section divided into 30, 30 and 20 m² parts. The largest part is 30/80=37.5%; at an assumed 1 m increment its in-situ excavation is 30 m³.

教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設軸力N=300 kN/m、厚t=0.20 m，單位寬平均應力N/t=1500 kPa=1.5 MPa；若合成試驗強度2 MPa，比值為0.75，未含分項係數。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume axial force N=300 kN/m and thickness t=0.20 m. Unit-width mean stress N/t=1500 kPa=1.5 MPa. Against synthetic test strength 2 MPa, the ratio is 0.75 before any partial factors.

教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設每米寬N=200 kN、M=10 kN·m、t=0.25 m，σ=N/t±6M/t²=0.8±0.96 MPa，兩緣為1.76與-0.16 MPa，負值表示拉應力。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. For a 1 m strip assume N=200 kN, M=10 kN·m and t=0.25 m. Stress is N/t±6M/t²=0.8±0.96 MPa: edges are 1.76 and -0.16 MPa, with negative indicating tension.

教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設同一增量荷載ΔF=600 kN，開口等效剛度20 kN/mm、閉合後60 kN/mm，位移增量分別30與10 mm；兩剛度均為教學假設。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume the same incremental force ΔF=600 kN. With equivalent stiffness 20 kN/mm before closure and 60 kN/mm after, displacement increments are 30 and 10 mm; both stiffnesses are teaching assumptions.

教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設單位寬A=0.25 m²、N=300 kN，E=6 GPa時ε=N/(EA)=200微應變；E=12 GPa時為100微應變，未包含徐變與收縮。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume unit-width area A=0.25 m² and N=300 kN. At E=6 GPa, ε=N/(EA)=200 microstrain; at E=12 GPa it is 100 microstrain, excluding creep and shrinkage.
